data_quality_notice: This research starter catalog contains 250 records across 17 brands; records are not all independently verified at individual product-page level.
Full INCI is recorded in 6 records; 244 records do not contain a full INCI list.
160 records contain ingredient highlights only, while 84 records contain neither ingredient highlights nor a full INCI list.
A record-level full INCI list is not a guarantee that the currently sold batch or regional packaging has the same formulation; check the physical pack.
Records marked brand_page_candidate_requires_product_page_verification are excluded from default recommendations.
official_catalog_listing_seen means a brand/catalog listing was seen; it does not prove the individual product page, current availability, or complete INCI.
No prices or current availability are claimed. Availability remains unverified.
Ingredient highlights, skin-type tags, concern tags, and automated matches are informational metadata, not medical advice or a diagnosis.

Pregnancy, trying-to-conceive, sensitivity, and ingredient-exclusion screening is withheld when a complete INCI list is unavailable; this is a data limitation, not a declaration that a product is safe or unsafe.

general_usage_guidance_not_product_speci.cleanser: Use as directed on the current product label; avoid eye contact and stop if irritation occurs.
general_usage_guidance_not_product_speci.serum: Introduce one new active at a time; follow the product label and stop if persistent irritation occurs.
general_usage_guidance_not_product_speci.moisturizer: Apply as directed; choose texture based on comfort and skin needs.
general_usage_guidance_not_product_speci.sunscreen: Use a broad-spectrum sunscreen as directed on the label; apply generously and reapply according to label directions, especially after swimming, sweating, or towel drying.
general_usage_guidance_not_product_speci.exfoliant: Use only according to the product label; avoid stacking multiple exfoliating actives at first.
general_usage_guidance_not_product_speci.retinoid: Can irritate skin; use label directions and consult a qualified clinician during pregnancy or when trying to conceive.
general_usage_guidance_not_product_speci.spot_treatment: Use only as directed; some actives can irritate or bleach fabrics.
